spans.s:
dráviṇa, n. movable property (as opp. to
house and field), wealth. [√dru, 1177b.]

√1drā (drā́ti; dadraú; ádrāsīt; intens.
[1002c, 1024^2] daridrāti). run; intens.
run about, run hither and thither. [cf.
δι-δρά-σκω, ‘run’: see √dru.]
+ apa, run off. [cf. ἀπο-δρᾶναι, ‘run
off.’]

√2drā (drā́ti; drā́yate; dadraú; ádrāsīt;
drāsyáti; drāṇá). sleep. [cf. ἔδραθον,
‘slept’; Lat. dormīre, ‘sleep.’]
+ ni, go to sleep; sleep.

√drāgh, only in derivs. drag, draw; draw
out; extend; lengthen. [poss. for *dhragh
(cf. √dhraj), and akin w. Eng. drag: but
see dīrghá.]

drā́ghīyāṃs, a. longer, as comp. to dīrghá.
[√drāgh, 467.]
